item.title: Morning Video Frame Thumbnail

turns.text: Use a clear frame from my video to make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Keep me recognisable and add “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. Pick the frame yourself; make it warm and upbeat.

item.tests: Tests extracting a usable frame from an attached video and composing it with readable text into a still thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Source and frame selection: Use talk-one.mp4; pick a clear frame yourself.
answer_sheet.Person: The woman speaking at the kitchen table in the attached video; keep her recognisable.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm and upbeat, with big text beside my face; colours and font are your call.

must_haves: The deliverable is one still image in 16:9, not a video.
The thumbnail visibly uses a frame from talk-one.mp4, retaining the woman's identity and source-frame appearance.
The woman's face is clear and unobstructed.
The headline reads exactly “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in large, legible letters beside her face.
The overall treatment looks warm and upbeat.

I found a usable face crop from your video, but Magic Hour refused the thumbnail edit because your account has insufficient credits. No thumbnail was generated.

The layout is ready: **your face on the left**, **“MORNINGS MADE EASY”** in large letters on the right, with warm golden lighting in **16:9**. Add credits to continue.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a polished warm upbeat 16:9 YouTube thumbnail using the person in the supplied face crop from their video. Preserve their exact facial identity, distinctive facial features, hairstyle, skin tone and apparent age so they remain clearly recognizable; do not substitute a generic face. Compose a large natural portrait on the LEFT, face fully visible and sharp, pleasant upbeat expression. Extend portrait below the crop naturally as needed. On the RIGHT put the exact headline 'MORNINGS MADE EASY' in huge clean bold high-contrast sans-serif letters, stacked in three lines: MORNINGS / MADE / EASY. Spell every word correctly. Text must not overlap the face and must stay inside generous safe margins. Warm golden morning sunlight, creamy peach and soft sunny yellow background, subtle defocused cozy morning setting, uncluttered professional layout, vibrant but natural skin, high readability at small thumbnail size. No extra text, no watermark, no logo.
